sources.sourceBasis: Municipality-level 2014 County Business Patterns data for Puerto Rico.

sources.publisher: Departamento de Estado, Plataforma de Educacion Superior
sources.sourceBasis: Puerto Rico higher education institution directory that can replace or refresh the legacy unis endpoint after field mapping.
sources.notes: This resource was published after the 2016 hackathon, so it is not confirmed original input.

sources.sourceBasis: Official Puerto Rico municipality boundary data.
sources.notes: Candidate for municipality reference data and future map geometry work; do not import geometry into the read API until the target schema is designed.

sources.sourceBasis: Puerto Rico-filtered postsecondary school point locations with latitude and longitude.

sources.sourceBasis: Direct Census API fallback for 2014 CBP data, constrained to Puerto Rico by FIPS state code 72.
sources.notes: Use only if the Datos.PR CBP files are unavailable or insufficient.

unresolvedTargets.reason: Reviewed adjacent public sources do not provide the preserved legacy joins end to end: cdepts requires career-department semantics beyond NAICS values, businesses requires point business rows plus cdepts/NAICS joins, and grade_cs requires university-to-career-department rate by year.
